What are Michael Jackson's children doing today?


#facts #viral #factuuuaman #shorts

Their lives took very different directions after growing up in the shadow of the King of Pop. Prince has been involved in charity and film-related projects, Paris has built her own career in music and acting, while Bigi has largely stayed away from the spotlight and explored filmmaking.

snippet.title: Paris Jackson’s $600 Million Battle Over Her Father’s Fortune
snippet.description:
On October 29, 2026, Paris Jackson filed a petition in the Los Angeles County Superior Court concerning the financial management of the Estate of Michael Jackson.
The court filing requests a judicial order requiring long-serving estate executors John Branca and John McClain to disburse $600 million into the Michael Jackson Family Trust, an entity established to support Jackson's three children and designated charities. The petition contends that formal distribution to the trust has faced prolonged delays since 2009, despite substantial revenue from commercial catalog agreements, theatrical productions, and digital licensing.
Representatives for the executors maintain that ongoing federal tax assessments and administrative obligations govern the timing of final distributions, with legal proceedings ongoing.

snippet.title: La batalla de 600 millones de dólares de Paris Jackson por la fortuna de su padre
snippet.description:
El 29 de octubre de 2026, Paris Jackson presentó una petición ante el Tribunal Superior del Condado de Los Ángeles en relación con la gestión financiera de la herencia de Michael Jackson.
El escrito presentado ante el tribunal solicita una orden judicial que obligue a los albaceas de larga trayectoria de la herencia, John Branca y John McClain, a desembolsar 600 millones de dólares en el Michael Jackson Family Trust, una entidad creada para apoyar a los tres hijos de Jackson y a organizaciones benéficas designadas. La petición sostiene que la distribución formal al fideicomiso ha enfrentado retrasos prolongados desde 2009, a pesar de los ingresos sustanciales provenientes de acuerdos comerciales de catálogo, producciones teatrales y licencias digitales.
Los representantes de los albaceas sostienen que las evaluaciones fiscales federales en curso y las obligaciones administrativas determinan el calendario de las distribuciones finales, mientras los procedimientos legales continúan.

snippet.title: Why Paris Jackson Is Seeking $600 Million From Michael Jackson Estate | E! News
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson is taking legal action against her father Michael Jackson’s estate, claiming she and brothers Prince Jackson and Bigi Jackson haven’t received the proper funds in their trust. In the Oct. 29 filing, Paris claims that while the estate has generated billions of dollars since her father’s 2009 passing, neither she nor her siblings have received its funding in the trust “Michael intended" to provide for them. The 28-year-old is asking a Los Angeles judge to order a partial distribution of the estate’s assets to the Michael Jackson Family Trust, which was set up to take care of Michael’s three kids financially. snippet.title: Paris Jackson Heard Michael Say THIS #michaeljackson #parisjackson
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson recently shared one of the funniest and most unexpected stories about her father, Michael Jackson. During her August 31, 2026 conversation with Zane Lowe for Apple Music’s The Zane Lowe Interview Series, Paris remembered Michael waking her up in the middle of the night while carrying an antique lantern.
The two quietly walked across Michael’s property when a car suddenly drove by. Paris said Michael took off running and the lantern went flying.
Then she heard her dad say:
“Shit. I fucked myself up.” 😂
It’s a hilarious little glimpse into Michael Jackson the father completely different from the larger-than-life image the world knew.
Paris Jackson’s conversation with Zane Lowe touched on her childhood, her relationship with Michael, her music, grief, and memories of growing up with one of the most famous people in the world.
Source: The Zane Lowe Interview Series; Paris Jackson with Zane Lowe, Apple Music, August 31, 2026.
